description: This file contains internal definitions, macros, and function prototypes for DES encryption within the BoringSSL cryptographic library, including bit manipulation macros and permutation operations.

methods.name: c2l
methods.description: Converts a sequence of bytes to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: l2c
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit unsigned integer to a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: c2ln
methods.description: Reads multiple bytes into two 32-bit integers, used for parsing.

methods.name: l2cn
methods.description: Writes two 32-bit integers into a byte sequence.

methods.name: PERM_OP
methods.description: Performs a permutation operation used in DES IP/FP transformations.

methods.name: IP
methods.description: Performs the initial permutation (IP) in DES.

methods.name: FP
methods.description: Performs the final permutation (FP) in DES.

methods.name: LOAD_DATA
methods.description: Loads data into variables for DES round processing.

methods.name: D_ENCRYPT
methods.description: Performs a DES round encryption step.
